The lab exercise is carried out using [R](https://www.r-project.org/) and the [lidR-package](https://github.com/r-lidar/lidR). The [lidRBook](https://r-lidar.github.io/lidRbook/) is a fantastic resource! TAKE A LOOK AT [CHAPTER 7](https://r-lidar.github.io/lidRbook/itd.html).

# Packages and data

```{r}
library(lidR)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# the watershed algorithm need EBImage - needs to be installed with code below. If issues use dalponte2016 instead.
#install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install("EBImage")

# REFERENCE DATA
plots <- read_sf("data/vaaler_train.gpkg","plots") #if error "tibble" use  st_read()
trees <- read_sf("data/vaaler_train.gpkg","trees")
```

# Individual tree detection and segmentation 

The examples used here presents watershed and region growing from local maximas. 

```{r}
las <- readLAS("data/train/plotid_76.las") # Read a las file 
#trees1 <- subset(trees,PlotID == 11 & DBH > 100) # Subsetting trees for a plot and DBH 
trees1 <- subset(trees,PlotID == 76)
#plot(las)
#las <- normalize_height(las, tin())  # Data provided already normalized
chm <- rasterize_canopy(las, 0.25, pitfree(subcircle = 0.2)) # Create a XHM
# Smooth canopy height model 
kernel <- matrix(1,3,3) # Defining moving window filter of 3 by 3 with equal weights
schm <- terra::focal(chm, w = , fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
#Do segmentation, possible also with other algorithm 

#WATERSHED 
algo_ws <- watershed(chm,th_tree=3) 
wsh <- segment_trees(las,algo_ws)
#plot(wsh,color="treeID") # LAS plot

# Create Crowns 
crowns <- crown_metrics(wsh,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "convex") # Polygons
ttops <- crown_metrics(wsh,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "point") #Points 

# ALTERNATIVE CODE FOR DALPONTE2016
#loc <- locate_trees(las,algorithm = lmf(2))
#dal <- segment_trees(las,dalponte2016(schm,loc,th=2,th_seed = 0.45,th_cr=0.55))
#crowns <- crown_metrics(dal,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "convex") # Polygons
#ttops <- crown_metrics(dal,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "point") #Points

#Plot
col <- height.colors(50)
plot(schm,col=col)
plot(st_geometry(trees1),add=T)
plot(st_geometry(crowns),add=T)
plot(st_geometry(plots),add=T,lws=2)
plot(st_geometry(ttops),add=T,pch=3)
st_crs(ttops) <- st_crs(trees1)
ttops <- st_intersection(ttops,plots) #Only identified trees on the plot 
plot(st_geometry(ttops),add=T,pch=19,cex=2)
```
## Evaluate accuracy for a plot 

```{r}
nn <- st_distance(ttops,trees1,by_elemtent=T)
dim(nn)

ttops$DET <- apply(nn,1,which.min)
ttops$DIST <- apply(nn,1,min)

det <- ttops %>% filter(DIST < 3) %>% group_by(DET) %>% slice_min(order_by=DIST) # Detected trees 
com <- ttops %>% filter(treeID %in% det$treeID == FALSE) # Commission
detected <- nrow(det)
commisions <- nrow(com)
omm<- trees1[-det$DET,] # Omission
ommissions <- nrow(omm)

DET <- detected/nrow(trees1) * 100
OM <- ommissions/nrow(trees1) * 100
COM <- commisions / nrow(trees1) * 100
AI <- 100 - (OM + COM)

TP <- detected
FP <- commisions
FN <- ommissions 

(Precision = TP / (TP + FP))
(Recall = TP / (TP + FN))
(F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall))

acc <- data.frame(DET=DET,OM=OM,COM=COM,AI=AI,Precision=Precision,Recall=Recall,F1=F1)
acc
plot(schm,col=col)
plot(st_geometry(trees1),add=T,pch=3)
plot(st_geometry(det),pch=19,add=T,col="black")
plot(st_geometry(com),pch=19,add=T,col="white")
plot(st_geometry(plots),add=T,lws=2)
```



# Creating a loop to run on all the data 

```{r, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
out_ttops <-out_itc <- c()
ctg <- catalog("data/train/")
for(i in c(1:nrow(ctg))){
  print(i)
  las <- readLAS(ctg$filename[i])
  #las <- normalize_height(las, tin()) # Data provided already normalized
  chm <- rasterize_canopy(las, 0.25, pitfree(subcircle = 0.2))
  kernel <- matrix(1,3,3)
  schm <- terra::focal(chm, w = , fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ## WATERSHED 
  #algo_ws <- watershed(chm,th_tree=3)
  #wsh <- segment_trees(las,algo_ws)
  #crowns <- crown_metrics(wsh,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "convex")
  #ttops <- crown_metrics(wsh,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "point")
  
  # DALPONTE 
  loc <- locate_trees(las,algorithm = lmf(2))
  dal <- segment_trees(las,dalponte2016(schm,loc,th=2,th_seed = 0.45,th_cr=0.55))
  crowns <- crown_metrics(dal,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "convex") # Polygons
  ttops <- crown_metrics(dal,.stdtreemetrics, geom = "point") #Points 
  
  #YOURS 
  #????

  col <- height.colors(50)
  plot(schm,col=col)
  plot(trees,add=T)
  plot(st_geometry(crowns),add=T)
  plot(st_geometry(plots),add=T,lws=2)
  
 
  out_ttops <- rbind(out_ttops,ttops)
  out_itc <- rbind(out_itc,crowns)
}
saveRDS(list(out_ttops=out_ttops,out_itc=out_itc),"data/ITC_YourName.rds")
```

# Evaluate accuracy 

```{r, eval=TRUE}
st_crs(out_ttops) <- st_crs(trees)
nn <- st_distance(out_ttops,trees,by_elemtent=T)
dim(nn)

out_ttops$DET <- apply(nn,1,which.min)
out_ttops$DIST <- apply(nn,1,min)

out_ttops$UID <- c(1:nrow(out_ttops))
det <- out_ttops %>% filter(DIST < 3) %>% group_by(DET) %>% slice_min(order_by=DIST)
com <- out_ttops %>% filter(UID %in% det$UID == FALSE)
detected <- nrow(det)
commisions <- nrow(com)
omm<- trees[-det$DET,] #Not that alle trees are used not only the trees for a plot (e.g. trees1 )
ommissions <- nrow(omm)

DET <- detected/nrow(trees) * 100
OM <- ommissions/nrow(trees) * 100 
COM <- commisions / nrow(trees) * 100
AI <- 100 - (OM + COM)

TP <- detected
FP <- commisions
FN <- ommissions 

(Precision = TP / (TP + FP))
(Recall = TP / (TP + FN))
(F1 = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall))

acc <- data.frame(DET=DET,OM=OM,COM=COM,AI=AI,Precision=Precision,Recall=Recall,F1=F1)
acc
```
